name: mvp non-convergence owner escape crosses the REAL entry point — POST /api/ai-os/project/run-tests at iteration 1 escapes to the owner, not the blind loop (PHASE-55 W-2, R-10/S382 pattern)
description: The W-2 real-path scenario required by PROMPT-STAGE-55 R-10. Boots the workspace API server in-process on a temp root, seeds the loop to RUN_TESTS with iteration_count=1 via the REAL orchestration tools (start_loop → RUN_TESTS → loop_back → RUN_TESTS), then drives POST /api/ai-os/project/run-tests over live HTTP exactly as the UI does with a forced FAIL harness verdict. Asserts through the real surface: the R-16 escape fires (advanced false, mvp_review_pending true, no blind loop_back to BUILDER), the graph stays at RUN_TESTS with iteration 1, the block flips to AWAITING_OWNER_REVIEW, and the persisted mvp_report is FAIL_REVIEW.
